gaez.title: GAEZ suitability
gaez.advisory: Context only: never changes scores or crops.
gaez.scope: Low confidence: one grid cell near Sétif, not a field measurement.
gaez.conditions.low: Rainfed, low input, past climate. A comparison, not advice.
gaez.conditions.high: Rainfed, high input, past climate. A comparison, not advice.
gaez.outside: {crop}: no rating sampled for this field.
credits.role.gaez_v5: Independent crop suitability context at the Sétif story-field cell; rainfed comparison only, never a filter or score.
validation.cross.title: Cross-checks
validation.cross.intro: Independent records next to ITZA's numbers.
validation.cross.openet: Monthly water use: modeled ET vs. OpenET
validation.cross.quickstats: Season scores vs. county wheat yields
validation.cross.directional: Direction only, not a yield forecast. Scores use a fixed continuous winter-wheat replay with default soil and no irrigation.
validation.cross.etCaveat: Modeled ET for the same winter-wheat replay, by month. OpenET is also a model, not ground truth.
validation.cross.rainCaveat: Full September–August years. Compares IMERG Final with PRISM, not the POWER rain used by the replay. Both use gauges.
validation.cross.missing_imerg: Not compared: no IMERG series in these bundles.
validation.cross.openet_key_required: Not compared: no OpenET capture available.
validation.cross.noOverlap: No complete overlapping observations are available.
validation.cross.coverage: {count} paired periods ({unmatched} unmatched left out; reference has {reference}).
validation.cross.errorMetrics: Bias {bias} mm · RMSE {rmse} mm (ITZA minus reference).
validation.cross.direction: Year-to-year direction agrees in {agree} of {total} changes ({ties} ties left out).
validation.cross.unitsWater: Both columns are water depth in millimeters.
validation.cross.unitsYield: Unitless score vs county wheat yield (bu/acre): compared by rank and direction only.
validation.cross.rainErrorMetrics: Bias {bias} mm · RMSE {rmse} mm (IMERG minus PRISM).
